authority: CEO R328 — 14 BUYER_SENDABLE functional technology packages + 1 honest vacancy
principle: A BUYER_SENDABLE package tells a company: WHAT the technology is, WHAT evidence exists, WHAT is uncertain, WHAT would prove it, WHAT would kill it, and WHAT it costs to find out.

P-01.title: Predictive Multi-Segment Shunt with Occlusion-Isolation Control
P-01.what_it_is: A control law for a multi-segment CSF shunt that predicts impending catheter obstruction and pre-emptively redistributes drainage to healthy segments.
P-01.what_works: Computational model (225 ablations, 5-seed preregistration). External 3D verification via svMultiPhysics: 1D model agrees with 3D Navier-Stokes within 16%.
P-01.what_doesnt_work: Strict dual-invariant (peak ICP 22 > 20 mmHg target). 24h survival not achieved by either design (~14h). FDA nozzle benchmark disagrees (72%) because nozzle geometry ≠ shunt geometry.
P-01.what_is_uncertain: Real valve dynamics. Implantable flow sensor (doesn't exist commercially). Clinical benefit (30% revision reduction is MODELLED).
P-01.what_would_prove_it: V0 bench prototype: 4-segment shunt + COTS sensors + Arduino. Run 30 obstruction scenarios. If multi-segment peak ICP < single-segment in ≥80% of scenarios.
P-01.what_would_kill_it: If multi-segment shows no advantage over single-segment in bench testing. If implantable flow sensor cannot be developed.
P-01.buyer_action: Reproduce the computation (clone, run svMultiPhysics). Then build V0 bench prototype and test.

P-02.title: Adaptive ICP-Responsive Valve Profile
P-02.what_it_is: A shunt valve that adapts its opening profile to ICP trends, reducing pressure excursions during postural changes.
P-02.what_works: Computational model predicts 47.3% ICP excursion reduction vs fixed valve.
P-02.what_doesnt_work: Nothing falsified yet — but the 47.3% is entirely computational. No bench validation.
P-02.what_is_uncertain: Real valve dynamics. Whether adaptive profile tracks ICP fast enough in hardware.
P-02.what_would_prove_it: Bench: adaptive vs fixed valve in mock CSF loop, 10 runs × 5 postural scenarios. If adaptive excursion < 60% of fixed (≥40% reduction).
P-02.what_would_kill_it: If reduction < 20% (FAIL). If 20-40% (AMBIGUOUS → repeat with n=30).
P-02.buyer_action: Build mock CSF loop. Run the protocol. Compare adaptive vs fixed.

P-04.title: Catalytic Aβ Clearance via NEP-Immobilized Catheter
P-04.what_it_is: Neprilysin enzyme immobilized on catheter wall clears amyloid-β from CSF via mass-transport-limited contact time.
P-04.what_works: Computational model predicts 100% Aβ42 clearance. 4/8 engineering parameters frozen. Enzyme identity (NEP) selected.
P-04.what_doesnt_work: 4/8 biology parameters blocked (enzyme stability, CSF kinetics). V2 with enzyme is BLOCKED on wet-lab.
P-04.what_is_uncertain: Enzyme kinetics in CSF. Whether mass-transport limit holds in real geometry. Enzyme stability over 30 days.
P-04.what_would_prove_it: In vitro: NEP-coated catheter in Aβ42-spiked aCSF, 72h. If ≥80% Aβ42 cleared; control <10%.
P-04.what_would_kill_it: If <50% clearance. If enzyme deactivates in CSF within 24h.
P-04.buyer_action: Procure NEP, coat catheters, run Aβ42 ELISA at 0/24/72h.

P-07.title: Drainage-Priority Safety Floor Module
P-07.what_it_is: A passive safety mechanism that maintains minimum drainage when primary paths are obstructed.
P-07.what_works: Mechanism defined (extracted from P-04 safety module). Drainage model exists.
P-07.what_doesnt_work: Not independently tested. P-03's safety floor was falsified (floor too small, 0.001 mL/min/mmHg).
P-07.what_is_uncertain: Whether P-07's floor design avoids P-03's failure. Real drainage through floor under obstruction.
P-07.what_would_prove_it: Bench: catheter with/without floor, 70% obstruction. If drainage > 0.1 mL/min with floor.
P-07.what_would_kill_it: If drainage < 0.05 mL/min. If floor cannot be manufactured at required diameter.
P-07.buyer_action: Build obstruction rig. Test with/without floor. Measure flow rate.

P-09.title: Chemical ICP Transduction (Molecule Design Required)
P-09.what_it_is: A chemical system that transduces ICP changes to measurable optical/electrochemical signals, eliminating electronic implants.
P-09.what_works: Architecture concept (9-step specification). Screening model identified piezoelectric reservoir as best mechanism.
P-09.what_doesnt_work: 0/9 specification steps resolved. No molecule designed. No model output.
P-09.what_is_uncertain: Everything downstream of molecule design. This is a research direction, not a tested technology.
P-09.what_would_prove_it: Design and synthesize a molecule with: sensitivity >1 mmHg, response <0.1s, CSF stability >30 days.
P-09.what_would_kill_it: No molecule found after 12 months of medicinal chemistry. CSF destroys all candidate transduction mechanisms.
P-09.buyer_action: Evaluate as a research direction. Commission a medicinal chemistry team to search the design space.

P-10.title: Phase-Change Valve (n-Octadecane Repair)
P-10.what_it_is: A shunt valve actuated by phase-change material. n-eicosane failed (5.04s vs 5s limit); n-octadecane predicted to pass (0.34s from 15x ΔT speedup).
P-10.what_works: Computational repair: n-octadecane (melting point 28°C) provides 9°C temperature differential vs n-eicosane's 0.6°C. Predicted response 0.34s.
P-10.what_doesnt_work: n-eicosane (R308 original) FAILED at 5.04s. Repair budget = 1 (used on n-octadecane). If n-octadecane also fails → CEMETERY.
P-10.what_is_uncertain: Real phase-change dynamics in valve assembly. Thermal mass of full valve. Heat transfer in CSF.
P-10.what_would_prove_it: Bench: n-octadecane valve, pressure step 10→30 mmHg. If response < 5.0s (frozen threshold).
P-10.what_would_kill_it: If response ≥ 6.0s. Repair budget exhausted — no V3.
P-10.buyer_action: Fabricate n-octadecane valve prototype. Apply pressure step. Measure response time.

P-11.title: Phage Anti-Biofilm Coating (S. aureus Phage K + Ti)
P-11.what_it_is: Bacteriophage K immobilized on electrospun Ti-coated catheter surface to prevent S. aureus biofilm formation.
P-11.what_works: Evidence chain (phage K identified, Ti substrate selected, electrospun coating). Computational model.
P-11.what_doesnt_work: No physical validation. Phage stability on Ti in CSF unknown.
P-11.what_is_uncertain: Phage viability on Ti surface. Biofilm prevention in realistic bacterial challenge.
P-11.what_would_prove_it: In vitro: phage-coated vs uncoated Ti in S. aureus biofilm assay, 7 days. If biofilm <20% of control.
P-11.what_would_kill_it: If biofilm ≥50% of control. If phage deactivates in CSF within 24h.
P-11.buyer_action: Coat Ti catheters with phage K. Challenge with S. aureus. Measure biofilm (crystal violet, CFU).

P-12.title: Enzymatic Tau Clearance (Cathepsin D)
P-12.what_it_is: Cathepsin D enzyme immobilized on catheter wall to clear tau protein from CSF.
P-12.what_works: Computational model predicts 100% tau clearance. Enzyme (Cathepsin D) selected.
P-12.what_doesnt_work: No physical validation. Enzyme kinetics in CSF unknown.
P-12.what_is_uncertain: Enzyme stability in CSF. Tau substrate accessibility. Whether 100% model prediction survives real conditions.
P-12.what_would_prove_it: In vitro: Cathepsin D-coated catheter in tau-spiked aCSF, 72h. If ≥80% tau cleared.
P-12.what_would_kill_it: If <50% clearance. If enzyme deactivates in CSF.
P-12.buyer_action: Procure Cathepsin D, coat catheters, run tau ELISA at 0/24/72h.

P-13.title: Neuromorphic Shunt Failure Predictor
P-13.what_it_is: An ML-based predictor that forecasts shunt failure 24h before clinical symptoms using ICP + flow trends.
P-13.what_works: Computational model (conditional PASS, depends on P-15/P-16 energy). Algorithm designed.
P-13.what_doesnt_work: No real patient data tested. Energy dependency on P-15/P-16 (if those fail, P-13 fails).
P-13.what_is_uncertain: Prediction accuracy on real clinical data. Lead time in clinical setting. Whether P-15/P-16 energy is sufficient.
P-13.what_would_prove_it: Retrospective: train on 100+ patient-years of shunt data. If AUC ≥0.80, lead time ≥12h on held-out cohort.
P-13.what_would_kill_it: If AUC < 0.70. If P-15/P-16 energy harvesting is insufficient (P-13 is dead without power).
P-13.buyer_action: Obtain shunt patient dataset (ICP + flow + outcomes). Train predictor. Test on held-out cohort.

P-15.title: Self-Powered Sensing (Cardiac Harvesting + Capacitor)
P-15.what_it_is: Implantable sensing system powered by cardiac motion energy harvesting (1-40 μW) + capacitor storage. Eliminates battery replacement.
P-15.what_works: 99.9% uptime at P50 (10 μW harvest). 96-point operating envelope (SAFE/MARGINAL/UNSAFE). Published cross-check (Zurbuchen 2013, 16.7 μW in-vivo). Deterministic reproduction (seed=42).
P-15.what_doesnt_work: Zero-harvest death in 0.1h (no backup battery). Arrhythmia model (70% reduction) more aggressive than published (10-30%).
P-15.what_is_uncertain: Actual cardiac harvesting in target implant location. Whether 10 μW P50 is achievable in shunt geometry.
P-15.what_would_prove_it: Bench: cardiac harvesting measurement in target implant geometry. If measured ≥ 5 μW (P5 threshold).
P-15.what_would_kill_it: If measured < 1 μW (insufficient for any sensing). If cardiac motion in shunt location is too weak.
P-15.buyer_action: Reproduce the computation (clone, run script). Then measure cardiac harvesting in target geometry.

P-16.title: Transcranial NIR Photovoltaic Power (940nm)
P-16.what_it_is: 940nm NIR light through scalp/skull to implanted GaAs PV cell. Verified fluence 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² (~1000-1400 μW).
P-16.what_works: ACTUAL PyTissueOptics v2.0.1 executed (independent external software). MC convergence documented (CIs overlap). Published Jacques 2013 range confirmed. Reproducible (pip install).
P-16.what_doesnt_work: R308 diffusion approximation (744 μW) was conservative. MCX (GPU) not run (CUDA constraint). No experimental tissue measurement.
P-16.what_is_uncertain: Actual 940nm tissue transmission in shunt patients. Whether 1000+ μW is sufficient for target load. PV cell efficiency in vivo.
P-16.what_would_prove_it: Bench: 940nm LED + 5mm tissue phantom + GaAs PV cell. If measured power ≥ 500 μW.
P-16.what_would_kill_it: If measured < 100 μW (insufficient for any useful load). If tissue absorption is much higher than Jacques 2013.
P-16.buyer_action: pip install pytissueoptics, run script (get ~1.4 mW/cm²). Then bench: LED + phantom + PV cell.

P-20.title: Adaptive Glycan Immune Tolerance Surface (Anti-Fibrotic)
P-20.what_it_is: Dual anti-fibrotic surface: CD47-mimetic glycan (immune tolerance) + IL-10 analog released from PLGA (active inflammation suppression).
P-20.what_works: Computational model: IL-10 release 2468 ng/cm²/day at day 30 (24,680x above threshold). 4/4 attacks survived. Glycan density 5x above threshold. Buyer decision tree (PASS/FAIL/AMBIGUOUS).
P-20.what_doesnt_work: No physical validation. PLGA kinetics are MODELLED from published data. Glycan stability unknown.
P-20.what_is_uncertain: Actual IL-10 release in CSF. Glycan surface density degradation. In vivo fibrosis reduction.
P-20.what_would_prove_it: In vitro: PLGA-IL-10 catheter in aCSF, 30 days. If IL-10 ≥0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 AND glycan ≥10¹²/cm² AND total <10 µmol/cm² (toxicity).
P-20.what_would_kill_it: If IL-10 <0.1 at day 30. If toxicity exceeded. If glycan sheds rapidly.
P-20.buyer_action: Coat catheters with PLGA-IL-10 + glycan. Incubate in aCSF 30 days. Measure IL-10 (ELISA) and glycan (SPR).

P-14.title: CEMETERY: Yield-Matched Drainage — Negative Knowledge
P-14.what_it_is: A falsified approach to CSF drainage that tried to match drainage yield to CSF production.
P-14.what_failed: CSF flow variability (posture, activity, circadian) creates noise that limits yield estimation to ~18%. Target was 30%. Mechanism failure (SNR < 2).
P-14.buyer_value: A company can inspect this to AVOID the yield-matching approach. Reusable rule: calculate SNR before manufacturing any yield-matching candidate. If SNR < 2, kill before investing.
P-14.buyer_action: Read the cemetery package. Understand why yield-matching fails in CSF. Do not pursue this approach.

P-17.title: CEMETERY: Biohybrid Endothelial Monolayer — Negative Knowledge
P-17.what_it_is: A falsified approach that used living endothelial cells on catheter surface to create anti-thrombogenic lining.
P-17.what_failed: Endothelial cells cannot survive in CSF (no blood perfusion, insufficient nutrients). Survival rate 0.215 vs 0.3 threshold. Biological mechanism failure.
P-17.buyer_value: A company can inspect this to AVOID cellular surfaces in CSF. Reusable rule: use CSF-adapted cell types (ependymal) or synthetic alternatives (P-20 glycan). Do not use endothelial cells in CSF.
P-17.buyer_action: Read the cemetery package. Understand why cells die in CSF. Do not pursue cellular approaches for CSF-contacting surfaces.

P-19.title: CEMETERY: Distributed Micro-Shunt Swarm — Negative Knowledge
P-19.what_it_is: A falsified approach that used 10 parallel micro-channels for distributed drainage with claimed obstruction resilience.
P-19.what_failed: Under conductance-matched 3D Navier-Stokes testing (svMultiPhysics), the single channel BEATS the distributed architecture. At 50% matched obstruction: single 13.88 mmHg vs distributed 19.75 mmHg. The distributed advantage was an artifact of unmatched baseline conductance.
P-19.buyer_value: A company can inspect the 11-round falsification chain (R312-R322). Reusable rule: conductance-matched 3D verification required for any distributed-vs-single hydraulic comparison. 1D Poiseuille is insufficient — 3D effects can reverse the conclusion.
P-19.buyer_action: Read the cemetery package. Understand why distributed channels don't provide resilience beyond conductance matching. Do not pursue distributed drainage without matched controls.

vacancy.rationale: Reservoir exhausted. No credible replacement. 14 honest packages > 15 with weak candidate. Per CEO R323 §P6: 'A weak 15th asset damages the portfolio more than an explicit vacancy.'

buyer_sendable_count.note: 14 packages can leave the repository and go to real companies. 11 are active technologies with defined decisive experiments. 3 are negative-knowledge packages that prevent costly mistakes. The vacancy is honest.
